name: sanbs-ride-deployments
description: Deployment entry points for the four standalone SANBS RIDE role apps. The prototype itself lives in SANBS•RIDES/ — see deploy/DEPLOY_ROLES.md.

scripts.build:app: cd "SANBS•RIDES" && npm ci && npm run build
scripts.deploy:donor: npm run build:app && cd "SANBS•RIDES" && npm run package:donor
scripts.deploy:driver: npm run build:app && cd "SANBS•RIDES" && npm run package:driver
scripts.deploy:staff: npm run build:app && cd "SANBS•RIDES" && npm run package:staff
scripts.deploy:ops: npm run build:app && cd "SANBS•RIDES" && npm run package:ops
scripts.deploy:all: npm run build:app && cd "SANBS•RIDES" && npm run package:all
scripts.verify: cd "SANBS•RIDES" && npm run brand:verify && npm test && npm run check:ssr
